prefer_pot_fates.label: Prefer magic pots
prefer_pot_fates.tooltip: Go for a live magic pot FATE first and skip CEs while it is up, even if that pot is unticked in the event list.

preposition_to_pots.label: Wait at the next pot
preposition_to_pots.tooltip: Predict the next magic pot from the spawn cycle and wait near it before it appears.

pot_spawn_lead_minutes.label: Pot wait lead (minutes)
pot_spawn_lead_minutes.tooltip: How many minutes before the next pot spawns to leave for it.

farm_pot_chests.label: Open the pot coffer
farm_pot_chests.tooltip: After a pot, use the elixir, follow the compass hints to the coffer and open it.

farm_reroll_pot_chests.label: Search second-chance spots
farm_reroll_pot_chests.tooltip: Also search the coffer spots used by the second chance.

pot_fate_cutoff_minutes.label: Stop FATEs before a pot (minutes)
pot_fate_cutoff_minutes.tooltip: Do not start ordinary FATEs this close to the next pot, and drop ones not yet engaged. 0 disables.

pot_critical_encounter_cutoff_minutes.label: Stop CEs before a pot (minutes)
pot_critical_encounter_cutoff_minutes.tooltip: Do not start CEs this close to the next pot. 0 disables.

min_pot_fate_minutes_remaining.label: Minimum pot time left (minutes)
min_pot_fate_minutes_remaining.tooltip: Skip a pot FATE with less time left than this. 0 always goes.

max_fate_progress_percent.label: Skip FATEs at progress (%)
max_fate_progress_percent.tooltip: Skip FATEs at or above this progress, also while travelling. 0 disables.

leave_fate_travel_for_ce_seconds.label: Leave FATE travel for a CE (seconds)
leave_fate_travel_for_ce_seconds.tooltip: Drop a FATE not yet engaged for a CE whose registration has at most this many seconds left. 0 leaves for any startable CE. CEs with under 45 seconds left (plus the maximum delay when CE departure delay is on) are never picked, so smaller values never trigger.

leave_engaged_fate_for_critical_encounte.label: Leave mid-FATE for a CE
leave_engaged_fate_for_critical_encounte.tooltip: Also leave an ordinary FATE you are fighting, with the same timing. Magic pots are never left. You may still be in combat when leaving.

enable_automatic_treasure_hunt.label: Treasure hunt between activities
enable_automatic_treasure_hunt.tooltip: When the automator is idle and enough coffers are up (see the treasure settings' minimum percentages), start a treasure hunt. After a hunt ends, it waits for another activity before hunting again.

pause_auto_treasure_hunt_for_fates.label: Pause the hunt for FATEs
pause_auto_treasure_hunt_for_fates.tooltip: Pause the hunt when a FATE can be started, and resume after it.

pause_auto_treasure_hunt_for_pots.label: Pause the hunt for magic pots
pause_auto_treasure_hunt_for_pots.tooltip: Pause the hunt while a pot is live, about to spawn, or its coffer is being farmed.

pause_auto_treasure_hunt_for_critical_en.label: Pause the hunt for CEs
pause_auto_treasure_hunt_for_critical_en.tooltip: Pause the hunt when a CE can be registered for (only once out of combat).

auto_repair_threshold.label: Auto repair threshold (%)
auto_repair_threshold.tooltip: While idle at base camp, repair when any equipped item is at or below this condition. 0 turns it off.

auto_repair_method.label: Repair method
auto_repair_method.tooltip: Self-repair needs dark matter. Mender options fall back to self-repair when no mender is within 50 yalms.

auto_register_for_forked_tower.label: Walk to the Forked Tower pad when registration opens
auto_register_for_forked_tower.tooltip: While Forked Tower registration is open, drop any FATE or CE not yet started and wait on the pad. North Horn needs Knowledge 40. Blood's ciphers are still offered by hand. The automator turns off once inside the tower.

stay_mounted_while_waiting.label: Stay mounted while waiting
stay_mounted_while_waiting.tooltip: Keep the mount while waiting for a CE, a magic pot, or the Forked Tower; dismount when the fight starts.

max_return_delay_seconds.label: Random wait before Return (seconds)
max_return_delay_seconds.tooltip: After a FATE or CE, wait a random 0 to this many extra seconds before returning to base camp. 0 turns it off.
